author: Espoir School of Life
title: Hiring Storybook Illustrator (Paid Project)
content: 🎨 WE ARE HIRING: STORYBOOK ILLUSTRATOR (Paid Project) Espoir School of Life is looking for a creative Storybook Illustrator who can capture the stories written about Espoir School of Life. The stories are already written, and we now need an artist to bring these local narratives to life through vibrant illustrations. How to Apply: fill out our application form here: bit.ly/espoir-SI Be ready to share your: Contact Information, Portfolio Link, Expected Rate/Project Quotation.

author: Ellen (imaginariumarts)
title: Seeking ongoing artist for YouTube channel assets
content: ARTISTS AND DESIGNERS LISTEN UP!!! A pal of mine recently started his YouTube channel journey, and is seeking an ongoing artist to commission for assets! Preference given to those who can replicate Kirby style content and character drawing. You will be paid fair compensation, so be ready to send your rates. COMMENT BELOW to introduce yourself or DM for more. Contact via comments or DM.
